lines.say: a steroid hormone they make, which the body turns into testosterone and estrogen
prescription vaginal form eased painful sex after menopause in two 12-week trials
slightly better sexual function than placebo in menopausal women (small trials)
no better quality of life than placebo across 28 trials in menopausal women
slightly better quality of life and mood in adrenal insufficiency; not advised routinely
no gain in strength or muscle in two small trials in men
HDL, the good cholesterol, falls with oral use in postmenopausal women
acne and other male-pattern effects in about 15% of women vs under 3% on placebo
raises estrogen, a concern in breast or other hormone-sensitive cancers
some evidence suggests even short-term use may cause harm, such as liver damage
